hints.title: Group Equal Values
hints.text: Sort distinct cell values in ascending order and process all coordinates sharing the same value together.

hints.title: Connect Cells in Same Row or Column
hints.text: Use disjoint set union to group cells of identical value that share either a row or a column.

hints.title: Component Max Rank Update
hints.text: The rank of each connected component is one plus the maximum rank currently recorded in any of its rows or columns.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Processing cells independently without grouping equal values causes contradictory rank assignments.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set union over rows and columns takes O(m + n) per unique value block.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that equal elements in the same row/col form equivalence classes via DSU.
